description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of member of the Vadamarachchi Pradeshiya Sabha - Filling of  a vacancy in the Office of member of the Polonnaruwa Pradeshiya Sabha - Filling of a Cacancy in the Office of member of the Wennappuwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices about filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to death or resignation, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of newly elected members to fill these vacancies through a process managed by Returning Officers, which directly relates to electoral processes and local government elections.
